text_block_list.text:
After accompanying Dantsu Flame with her shopping,
we were walking through the shopping district when—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Huh? Looks like things are getting pretty lively over there.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle is underway~!
The grand prize is an all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
2nd prize is "Mountain of Carrots"!
3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the fun, fun lottery!
Anyone and everyone, come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Huh! A hot spring trip sounds so luxurious—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Ah!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: "That hot spring resort is where a classmate bought me a souvenir the other day."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Didn't they say the hot springs were amazing?
Said it was so relaxing and washed all the fatigue away...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...Um. Speaking of which, I got a raffle ticket
from our shopping earlier.
Do you mind if I give it a try?

And with that, Dantsu Flame was the one
to spin the raffle wheel!
And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!!
The Grand Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been won~~~~!!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: N-No way!?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"...P-People actually do win these raffles,
don't they!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Incredible...! It's an "Onsen Trip Voucher," Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Yes! Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...So, um!
If you'd like, would you want to go together?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, the classmate who went to that hot spring
went there together with her Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: So, they said it was wonderful because they got to talk about things they usually don't and discover new sides of each other.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Normally, I just end up talking endlessly about races and training, after all.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"I want to learn so much
more about you, Trainer!"
choice_data_list: I appreciate the thought, but are you really sure about this?
I appreciate the thought, but are you really okay with this?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Yes! Of course!
And so—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
I wonder what kind of place it is.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"I'll stick it on the wall later
so I won't forget♪"

Once things finally settled down,
the two of us decided to go on a hot springs trip.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~!
The prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Wah, hooray~!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"Still, it's quite huge, isn't it?
Maybe even bigger than the hamburger steak set at the academy cafeteria?"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, right.
Would you like to eat together, if you'd like?"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I think I can finish this amount, but...
the thing is, I eat a bit slowly.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: It looks like it might take a while, so I'd really appreciate it if you could split it with me... or something.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...Mmh, mmnh~!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"...*nom nom*...
...*nom nom*..."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
choice_data_list: (She really takes her time eating, doesn't she?)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

The two of them thoroughly enjoyed the
"Special Deluxe Carrot Hamburg Steak" together.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!!
The prize is a "Mountain of Carrots"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Wah, smells so good!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
It's glossy and heavy...
Could this actually be a really high-grade carrot?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
It feels a bit like a waste
for just the two of us to eat it all.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...That's it.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Huh? They're handing out carrots~☆
Can Maya and the others have some too?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
Here you go too, Brian-senpai.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: No need.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehhー! This is definitely sweet, you know!?
Take a bite, Brian-san!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: ...! This is—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
The color and gloss are magnificent.
It's almost like Funabashi's—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
N-No!
Though it doesn't quite measure up to Funabashi carrots...!
And so, the mountain of carrots vanished in the blink of an eye.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
3rd prize~!
The prize is "one carrot"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. We got lucky.
What a big, wonderful carrot~.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Maybe I should make something since I'm here――

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Mommyyy,
I want that big carrot too~.

text_block_list.name: Mother
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Sorry, but I don't have time to stop
by the supermarket today. I'll buy it for you tomorrow instead.

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Nooo, I wanna eat it now~!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"...Um!
Would you like this, if it's alright?"

text_block_list.name: Mother
text_block_list.text:
No, no, not at all!
I'm sorry for making such a fuss.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
No, I was just wondering what to do with it myself,
so you'd really be helping me out by taking it!

text_block_list.name: Mother
text_block_list.text:
I-Is that so...?
No, but—

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Big Sister~!

text_block_list.name: Mother
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, and thank you very much...!
Good luck in your race!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Not at all.
...Eat lots and grow big, okay?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
I got to see such a lovely smile.

Dants Flame looked on with satisfaction
as the young girl skipped all the way home.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost!
Your consolation prize is a pack of tissues~
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe.
As expected, I didn't win.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Still, I had just run out of tissues, so this is actually great timing.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Spinning the lottery wheel was thrilling too.
Thank you for keeping me company!

Dants Flame said so, though she still looked
a little disappointed nonetheless.
